Laban Infant Milk Formula – Stage 1, 2, 3 – Baby Milk Powder for Healthy Growth
Infant Formula Milk
Laban Infant Formula Milk is a nutritionally complete, scientifically formulated milk substitute designed for infants from birth to 24 months (depending on the stage). It provides essential nutrients for healthy growth and development.




 Variations:

 	Stage 1 (0-6 Months)
 	Stage 2 (6-12 Months)
 	Stage 3 (12-24 Months)
 	From 1  year to 2 year 






 Stages Guide:

 	
Stage 1: Suitable for newborns (0-6 months)

 	
Stage 2: For babies learning to sit and crawl (6-12 months)

 	
Stage 3: For active toddlers (12-24 months)

 Supports healthy growth and development Easy to digest Contains DHA for brain and eye development Prebiotics for gut health Rich in vitamins and minerals
